100vw" /></noscript></p><h3>Why You’ll Love This Copycat Nando’s Sweet Chilli Chicken and Halloumi Burger</h3><p data-slot-rendered-content="true">If you know me, you know I love a cheeky Nando’s. This <strong>sweet chilli chicken and halloumi burger</strong> brings all the flavours of your favourite meal right into your own kitchen.</p>
<div class="mv-ad-box" data-slotid="content_btf" style="height: 250px; width: max(300px, 100%); overflow: clip !important;"><div class="mv-rail-frame-250" data-slotid="content_btf"><div class="mv-rail-slide-250" data-slotid="content_btf"><div class="mv-rail-sticky-250" data-slotid="content_btf"><div id="content_btf_wrapper" class="adunitwrapper content_btf_wrapper" data-wrapper="content_btf" data-nosnippet="">

</div>
<p>What makes it even better is that this recipe uses an air fryer! Not only does it cook the chicken perfectly, but it’s also quick, convenient, and cost-effective. Of course, for those who don’t have an air fryer, I’ve included instructions for cooking it in a regular oven.</p><div class="mv-video-target mv-video__featured mv-video__optimized" data-video-id="CHPSWx8PAIgfxm4vvTOf" data-autoplay="true" data-automobile="true" data-muted="true" data-sticky="true" data-autoinsert="true" data-disable-jsonld="true" id="mv-first-video" style="min-height: 478px;"></div><h3>The Benefits of Using an Air Fryer</h3><p><a href="https://amzn.to/3ZMR7hj">Air fryers</a> have become one of my favourite kitchen gadgets, and for good reason. They cook food faster than traditional ovens and use significantly less energy, making them more cost-effective.</p><p>They also create a crispy texture without needing much oil. Whether you’re cooking chicken, veggies, or even desserts, an air fryer is a versatile addition to your kitchen.</p><h3>Equipment You’ll Need</h3><p>Before you start, make sure you have the following tools:</p><ul><li><strong><a href="https://amzn.to/3ZMR7hj">Air fryer</a> or oven</strong> – For cooking the chicken and halloumi.</li><li><strong>Meat mallet or rolling pin</strong> – To flatten the chicken for even cooking.</li><li><a href="https://amzn.to/4fwGBk3"><strong>Mixing bowl</strong></a> – For preparing the sauce.</li><li><strong>Tongs</strong> – To easily handle the chicken and halloumi.</li></ul><h3>Ingredients for Copycat Nando’s Sweet Chilli Chicken and Halloumi Burger</h3><h4>For the Burger:</h4><ul data-slot-rendered-content="true"><li><strong>1 chicken breast</strong></li><li><strong>2–3 slices halloumi cheese</strong></li><li><strong>1 bun or roll of your choice</strong></li><li><strong>1 medium tomato</strong>, sliced and salted</li><li><strong>Baby gem lettuce</strong></li><li><strong>Mayo or your sauce of choice</strong></li></ul>
<div class="mv-ad-box" data-slotid="content_2_btf" style="height: 250px; width: max(300px, 100%); overflow: clip !important;"><div class="mv-rail-frame-250" data-slotid="content_2_btf"><div class="mv-rail-slide-250" data-slotid="content_2_btf"><div class="mv-rail-sticky-250" data-slotid="content_2_btf"><div id="content_2_btf_wrapper" class="adunitwrapper content_btf_wrapper" data-wrapper="content_2_btf" data-nosnippet="">
          <div id="content_2_btf" class="content_btf adunit">
            
          </div>
        </div><mv-ad-reporter data-slot-id="content_2_btf" data-offering="1" data-offering-name="mediavine" data-offering-domain="mediavine.com"></mv-ad-reporter></div></div></div>
  
        
    
</div>
<h4>Seasoning:</h4><ul><li><strong>1-2 tsp Paprika</strong></li><li><strong>1/2 tsp Cayenne pepper</strong></li><li><strong>1/2 tsp Salt</strong></li><li><strong>1/4 tsp Black Pepper</strong></li></ul><h4>For the Sauce:</h4><ul><li><strong>2 tbsp sweet chili sauce</strong></li><li><strong>1 tsp honey</strong></li><li><strong>Dash of hot sauce</strong>, to taste</li></ul><h3>How to Make Copycat Sweet Chilli Nando’s Chicken and Halloumi Burger</h3><h4>Step 1: Prepare the Chicken</h4><p>Start by flattening the chicken breast with a meat mallet or rolling pin until it’s an even thickness. This ensures the chicken cooks evenly and stays juicy.</p><p>Season both sides generously with paprika, cayenne, salt, and pepper.</p><h4>Step 2: Make the Sauce</h4><p>In a small bowl, mix together the sweet chili sauce, honey, and a dash of hot sauce. Adjust the heat level to your preference by adding more or less hot sauce.</p><p data-slot-rendered-content="true">If you prefer a classic Nando’s vibe, you can swap this sauce for peri peri sauce instead.</p>
<div class="mv-ad-box" data-slotid="content_3_btf" style="height: 250px; width: max(300px, 100%); overflow: clip !important;"><div class="mv-rail-frame-250" data-slotid="content_3_btf"><div class="mv-rail-slide-250" data-slotid="content_3_btf"><div class="mv-rail-sticky-250" data-slotid="content_3_btf"><div id="content_3_btf_wrapper" class="adunitwrapper content_btf_wrapper" data-wrapper="content_3_btf" data-nosnippet="">
          <div id="content_3_btf" class="content_btf adunit">
            
          </div>
        </div><mv-ad-reporter data-slot-id="content_3_btf" data-offering="1" data-offering-name="mediavine" data-offering-domain="mediavine.com"></mv-ad-reporter></div></div></div>
  
        
    
</div>
<h4>Step 3: Coat the Chicken and Halloumi</h4><p>Brush the chicken breast with the prepared sweet chili sauce, ensuring it’s well coated. Do the same with the halloumi slices for an extra burst of flavor.</p><h4>Step 4: Cook in the Air Fryer</h4><p>Place the chicken breast in the air fryer basket and cook at <strong>200°C (400°F)</strong> for <strong>10 minutes</strong>.</p><p>After 10 minutes, add the halloumi slices to the air fryer and cook for an additional <strong>5 minutes</strong>, or until the halloumi is golden and crispy and the chicken is cooked through to 165F/75C.</p><h4>Step 5: Cook in a Regular Oven (Optional)</h4><p>If you don’t have an air fryer, preheat your oven to <strong>200°C (400°F)</strong> or <strong>180°C (350°F fan)</strong>. Bake the chicken on a lined tray for <strong>18–20 minutes</strong>, adding the halloumi slices for the last <strong>5 minutes</strong> of cooking.</p><h4>Step 6: Assemble the Burger</h4><p>Spread mayo or your sauce of choice on both sides of the bun. Start by layering the cooked chicken breast on the bottom half.</p><p>Next, add the halloumi slices, followed by the salted tomato slices and baby gem lettuce. Top with the remaining half of the bun and serve immediately.</p><h3>Why This Recipe is Perfect for Any Occasion</h3><p data-slot-rendered-content="true">This <strong>sweet chilli chicken and halloumi burger</strong> is not only packed with flavor but also versatile. It’s great for a quick weeknight dinner or as part of a casual gathering with friends.</p>
<div class="mv-ad-box" data-slotid="content_4_btf" style="height: 250px; width: max(300px, 100%); overflow: clip !important;"><div class="mv-rail-frame-250" data-slotid="content_4_btf"><div class="mv-rail-slide-250" data-slotid="content_4_btf"><div class="mv-rail-sticky-250" data-slotid="content_4_btf"><div id="content_4_btf_wrapper" class="adunitwrapper content_btf_wrapper" data-wrapper="content_4_btf" data-nosnippet="">
          <div id="content_4_btf" class="content_btf adunit">
            
          </div>
        </div><mv-ad-reporter data-slot-id="content_4_btf" data-offering="1" data-offering-name="mediavine" data-offering-domain="mediavine.com"></mv-ad-reporter></div></div></div>
  
        
    
</div>
<p>The air fryer makes it so easy to prepare, and the fresh ingredients keep it light yet satisfying. It’s the perfect balance of juicy chicken, crispy halloumi, and flavorful toppings.</p><h3>Tips for Success</h3><ol><li><strong>Flatten the Chicken</strong>: Always flatten your chicken breast to ensure even cooking and tenderness.</li><li><strong>Let the Sauce Shine</strong>: Don’t be shy with the sauce! Coating the chicken and halloumi ensures every bite is packed with flavour.</li><li><strong>Customize Your Toppings</strong>: Add avocado, pickles, or even extra sauce to make this burger your own.</li></ol><h3>Serving Suggestions</h3><p>Serve this burger with a side of sweet potato fries or a fresh green salad for a complete meal. If you’re hosting a gathering, consider pairing it with a selection of dips like peri peri mayo or garlic aioli.</p><p>For a more indulgent option, add a second layer of halloumi or cheese of your choice, or an extra drizzle of sweet chili sauce. It’s a recipe that’s easy to customize to your taste.</p><h3>Why You’ll Keep Coming Back to This Recipe</h3><p>This <strong>copycat Nando’s chicken and halloumi burger</strong> is everything you love about the restaurant version, made even better at home. It’s easy, quick, and uses simple ingredients you probably already have in your kitchen.</p><p>Whether you’re a fan of air fryers or prefer using a traditional oven, this recipe is adaptable and delicious every time. Once you try it, you’ll be making it again and again!</p><h3>Watch My Step-by-Step Video</h3><p data-slot-rendered-content="true">For a complete guide on how to make this <strong>Copycat Nando’s Chicken and Halloumi Burger</strong>, check out my video tutorial on the <a href="https://www.youtube.com/c/FitwaffleKitchen" target="_blank" rel="noopener" data-saferedirecturl="https://www.google.com/url?q=https://www.youtube.com/c/FitwaffleKitchen&source=gmail&ust=1735074033289000&usg=AOvVaw1s7uPmEv2391INKtKAvqmz">Fitwaffle Kitchen YouTube channel</a>.
